fields.name: observation_id
fields.description: Stable Peak Country identifier for one underlying ground/reporting observation lineage.

fields.name: identity_status
fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the observation identity.

fields.name: event_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date used for annual/monthly/hail-day reporting.

fields.name: observation_time_local
fields.description: Canonical source-local observation timestamp without inventing an offset.

fields.name: observation_time_utc
fields.description: Canonical observation timestamp normalized to UTC only when source timezone can be resolved deterministically.

fields.name: time_normalization_status
fields.description: Explains whether the canonical local time could be normalized reliably to UTC.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Reporting year derived from event_date_local.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Reporting month number derived from event_date_local.

fields.name: state_name
fields.description: Normalized state name for V1 observation geography.

fields.name: state_fips
fields.description: Two-character state FIPS preserving leading zeroes.

fields.name: county_name
fields.description: Approved county name used for V1 observation classification.

fields.name: county_fips
fields.description: Three-character county FIPS preserving leading zeroes.

fields.name: county_geoid
fields.description: Five-character state+county GEOID.

fields.name: geographic_classification_status
fields.description: Agreement/conflict state between source and derived geography.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Approved usable observation latitude for coordinate-dependent derived outputs.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Approved usable observation longitude for coordinate-dependent derived outputs.

fields.name: coordinate_status
fields.description: Usability/availability state for observation coordinates.

fields.name: canonical_reported_location
fields.description: Location wording from the canonical source representation, preserved as source-derived display context.

fields.name: normalized_display_location
fields.description: Optional cleaned display/community label that does not claim city-limit membership.

fields.name: hail_magnitude_inches
fields.description: Canonical role-specific hail magnitude in inches; never an average of conflicting source values.

fields.name: measurement_status
fields.description: Nature of the canonical measurement/assertion.

fields.name: canonical_source_role
fields.description: Role of the canonical source representation for this observation.

fields.name: evidence_class
fields.description: Observation-level evidence summary class.

fields.name: independent_supporting_observation_count
fields.description: Number of other confirmed independent ground-observation lineages associated with the same event group under T03/T09 rules.

fields.name: independent_corroboration_status
fields.description: Whether independent supporting ground observations are established.

fields.name: radar_context_status
fields.description: Whether MRMS/MESH context is associated separately from ground observations.

fields.name: conflict_status
fields.description: Summary state indicating whether material source conflicts remain for this observation.

fields.name: duplicate_candidate_status
fields.description: Summary state for unresolved/resolved duplicate-candidate relationships.

fields.name: distance_from_greeley_miles
fields.description: WGS84 ellipsoidal distance from frozen Lincoln Park reference, in statute miles.

fields.name: greeley_25mi_status
fields.description: Eligibility for the derived Greeley 25-mile subset.

fields.name: distance_bin
fields.description: Descriptive distance band under T05 semantics.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Sorted controlled public-safe quality/limitation codes derived from issues.

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset release version containing this row.

fields.name: methodology_version
fields.description: Methodology version used to derive this row.
